_doc: Face lane round F2: which face each key still wears when the render path runs with ROSACE_FACES=f2 (faces.v2_face -> tools/art-construct/face_f2.py). Keyed by pose name, then px ('*' = every size, a px key overrides it). Gaze targets: idle and back view at the viewer, N1 at the enemy (the way she faces), Q with closed smiling eyes. N1 drops F1's shout (critique F1 2g: no teeth block unless Ignited). Q's eyes are pulled in from the projection (far_dx / near_dx): on the tilted front head the projected far eye sits on the hair edge. Picks from round F2 (ART-RULES learning log). Round F2b (second pass of round 2): the same picks drawn with the F2b library (one eye template per view, OL brows over the fringe at 144, lash/brow clipped at the face contour, three skin tones; face_f2_lib.py).
